title: the reunion
hook: one last show with the band you walked out on.
openingLines: ten years since you walked out.
the old venue closes next week.
setting: A grimy rehearsal room and a sold-out small venue, in the city where you all grew up.
tone: loud, nostalgic, and funny about getting older

self.description: You used to be the best drummer anyone knew. Now you teach maths.
self.want: To play one more time, and to make it right.

cast.name: Benji
cast.description: Big-hearted frontman, still broke, still dreaming.
cast.want: For the show to be the start of something.
cast.avoids: Admitting he's already booked a tour.
cast.closeness: you started the band together at sixteen
cast.tension: he never forgave you for leaving

cast.name: Kit
cast.description: Calm, wry, the one who kept in touch.
cast.want: For everyone to get through one night without a fight.
cast.closeness: they sent you a birthday card every year

opening.title: The show
opening.description: Ten years ago you put down your sticks mid-song and walked out.

opening.title: The invitation
opening.description: Kit wrote: one show, for the old place before it closes. Benji wants you.

opening.title: The rehearsal room
opening.description: You open the door. Benji turns round with the setlist and doesn't smile.

background: The venue closes for good after this show.
You walked out because you found out Benji had signed a deal without you.
